pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with high-contrast sharp edge gradients. Individual dark regions exhibit stellate-like projections and variable spatial area across the flank and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light cream-colored pathways. Intersections are multi-nodal, and pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible along the upper neck, representing the short mane structure against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A prominent structural disruption exists at the shoulder-neck junction where a raised, textured mass breaks the linear continuity of the dorsal profile.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive area of greyish, multi-nodular textural disruption and hyper-pigmented crusting on the upper shoulder and dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, raised, greyish-white textured lesion is present on the dorsal shoulder, characterized by thickened and irregular skin surface geometry.
